name: Arno Baumgartner
bio: Arno's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching his father, a local rally driver, compete in regional events. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics, before transitioning into a performance engineer role within a small Swiss touring car team. His meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making quickly earned him recognition. After several successful seasons, he joined Mitsubishi Motorsport as a junior engineer, steadily climbing the ranks due to his technical aptitude and leadership potential. Arno believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, pushing his team to analyze every detail and optimize performance at every stage. He is determined to bring Mitsubishi back to the top.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Arno is of average height with a slender build and intense eyes that reflect his focused nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting precisely on time, regardless of who's late.
